content:
carla_sales: Quick sync — BankRoll (mid-market fintech) kicked off a POC. Integrating via our Node SDK + edge websocket proxy. Two immediate issues: structured tool_call objects sometimes arrive as partial JSON (parse errors) during stream bursts, and they saw 429s during replay tests. Procurement also wants short guidance on temporary pricing & SSO requirements.

deo_se: Partial JSON on ws usually means the proxy is slicing frames mid-event. If they rely on event framing (SSE-style) we must ensure each logical event is self-contained. Can you paste a sample capture?

carla_sales: From their logs (redacted):\n`{"type":"tool_call","name":"enrich_account","args":{"acct":"X"}}` then next chunk begins `"metadata":...` so client sees `Unexpected token` on JSON.parse.

mayra_se: Shortfixs: 1) make adapter buffer until a full event boundary (

 for SSE or length-prefixed for WS), 2) server can emit NDJSON lines so each line is parseable. Recommend the adapter add a small reassembly loop.

deo_se: Tiny adapter snippet (JS):
```js
let buf=''; function onWs(msg){ buf += msg; let idx; while((idx = buf.indexOf('\n')) !== -1){ const line = buf.slice(0, idx); buf = buf.slice(idx+1); if(!line.trim()) continue; try{ const obj = JSON.parse(line); handle(obj); }catch(e){ // keep buffering if malformed
 buf = line + '\n' + buf; break; } } }
```

carla_sales: Nice. What about the 429s? They reported spikes when replaying 400 concurrent sessions.

infra_bot: Created ticket INF-9901: bankroll-poc-concurrency-bump. Requestor: carla_sales. Expires in 12 days.

finance_yu: For short presales: we can authorize a complimentary concurrency bump (7-14 days) for validated trials. If they keep usage high, move to reserved Dedicated or usage billing. Blurb I usually send to procurement: "Temporary hosted concurrency increases may be granted for POCs up to 14 days. Continued or elevated capacity will be subject to standard usage rates or dedicated capacity agreements after telemetry review."

carla_sales: Procurement also asked about SSO + SCIM and SOC2.

legal_sue: We can support SSO via SAML or OIDC for Dedicated/Private customers; for hosted we offer SAML for admin console and recommend SCIM for provisioning. SOC2 attestation and KMS docs attached upon request. I'll prep the compliance packet and pre-fill the security questionnaire.

mayra_se: Action checklist I suggest we share with BankRoll:\n- Run a short reproducer with verbose SDK logs (REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1).\n- If using WS: switch to NDJSON or length-prefixed frames so adapter can parse per-message.\n- Add client buffering that waits for newline or length boundary before JSON.parse.\n- Provide concurrent stream count and tokens/s if 429s persist so infra can decide temporary bump vs routing to cheaper model shard.\n- If they need enterprise features (SAML/SCIM/KMS), loop legal for DPA and recommend Dedicated for residency.

carla_sales: I'll send the reproducer + adapter snippet and offer the 10-day bump. Any short note about cost impact to include?

finance_yu: Include: "POC bump is complimentary for up to 10 days for vetted pilots; token usage beyond free credits will be billed at hosted rates. Dedicated options require a capacity commitment and are quoted separately."

deo_se: If they want live debugging, I can join a short session to tail the adapter logs and confirm framing. Ping me with timezone.

carla_sales: Will do. Closing for now — will update when repro runs. :rocket:
